TO: Head of Department, Robotics
FROM: Lab In-charge
SUBJECT: Sanction of ₹75,000 for purchase of Digital Oscilloscopes

This is to request sanction for the procurement of 3 Digital Oscilloscopes (Model: Tektronix TBS 2104) for the Advanced Electronics Lab at an estimated cost of ₹75,000.

Justification: The current oscilloscopes are 8 years old and lack modern features required for signal analysis in robotics projects. The new equipment will enhance student learning outcomes in embedded systems courses.

Precedent: Similar equipment was sanctioned vide order NS-20240615-002 for ₹80,000.

Rules Cited: GFR Rule 153 (procurement thresholds), GGSIPU Equipment Purchase Guidelines 2023.

Approval Chain: Lab In-charge → HoD → Dean (for amounts above ₹50,000)

Supporting Documents: Quotations (3), Comparative Statement, Technical Specifications, Purchase Committee Approval

Approved Amount: ₹75,000
Status: Approved on 2025-01-15

TO: Dean, Engineering
FROM: Department of Automation
SUBJECT: Sanction of ₹1,20,000 for Industrial Robot Arm

Request for procurement of 1 Industrial Robot Arm (6-DOF) for the Automation Lab at ₹1,20,000.

Justification: Required for Industry 4.0 training program. Current equipment inadequate for teaching modern automation techniques.

Precedent: Robot procurement approved vide NS-20230920-005 for ₹1,50,000.

Rules Cited: GFR Rule 153, GGSIPU Capital Equipment Guidelines, Make in India preference under Rule 159.

Approval Chain: HoD → Dean → Finance Committee → Director

Supporting Documents: Quotations (3), Technical Evaluation Report, Purchase Committee Minutes, Budget Approval

Status: Approved on 2024-11-30
